meaning: A car that uses cameras and computers to steer and brake with little help from a driver.
clues: A vehicle that does much of the driving itself.
Cameras and sensors watch the road all around it.
A computer decides when to steer, speed up, and brake.
Some cities have taxis like this, with no driver in the front seat.
It has three words, and the first is joined by a hyphen. The first starts with S.
assumes: Cruise control only holds your speed
An electric car runs on a battery

decoys.meaning: A car feature that holds your speed so you can lift your foot. You still steer.
A system that uses signals from satellites to show where you are and give directions.
A car that runs on a battery and a motor instead of a gas engine.

exchange.speaker: floyd
exchange.text: Back in my day, driving took both hands, both eyes, and a paper map. Now the car reads the map?

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: Most cars today only help. Tip: with driver help features, you must still watch the road and be ready to take over.
